title: fix(ui): suggest usage filters beyond the first six catalog entries
body:
Supersedes #171051, thanks @ooiuuii.

Closes #171050

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Usage autocomplete omits matching models, providers, agents, channels, and tools beyond the first six catalog entries.

## User Impact

Typing a filter can discover any matching catalog value, with at most six suggestions shown. Spelling, ordering, and quoted multiword values are preserved. No migration or configuration change is needed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing suggestion owner now matches before applying the display cap. This deliberately accepts full-catalog matching requested in #171051 while retaining the six-result limit.

Production: +1 line for the post-match cap; the redundant empty-value predicate was removed in the same expression. Tests: −17 lines by replacing the capped test-helper fixture with the actual matcher contract. No unrelated production deletion was warranted.

## Evidence

- Baseline: `546523f8cfc7bf809d653241658e74ebba86af6d` (current main at investigation). The committed regression failed with `[]` instead of the later agent matches. After the fix, query + view tests passed: 24 tests, 3.21s wrapper wall time. The regression covers all five categorical keys, quoted input, spelling, missing matches, and the six-result cap.
- Focused Chromium proof through the actual `/usage` source route and real `buildUsageOverview` producer, with synthetic mock Gateway transport: before, `model:seventh` offers no suggestion; after, `model:seventh-model` appears, clicking and pressing Enter sends `sessions.usage` with the selected query and displays only its matching session. RED 9.03s; GREEN 5.25s wrapper wall time. This was a temporary proof harness, not a live Gateway/provider or bundled-build claim.
- `pnpm tsgo:ui`, scoped type-aware oxlint, formatting, and `git diff --check` passed. Exact-head [PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41279405330) passed, including all three UI shards and the selected browser E2E shard. Workflow elapsed time was about 9m26s; UI job durations were 4m17s–4m44s and E2E 1m20s (job timings, not individual-test timings).
- Simplification pass: only the existing matcher and its regression changed; no new owner or helper.
- Local autoreview (Codex, P0–P2, base above → local snapshot committed as `6e064d3f1055`) produced one P2 finding, rejected after source verification: `buildUsageFilterOptions` is a test-only helper, not the production catalog producer. Production `src/shared/usage-overview.ts` returns uncapped catalogs, the view consumes them directly, and the successful browser proof exercises that producer. No actionable findings remain; this is not a claim that autoreview returned clean.
- Contributor code was read using `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff` only and was never checked out or run on this host. Human commit credit: `Co-authored-by: luyifan <al3060388206@gmail.com>`.
